role: The bonus chest placed near spawn when a world is created with the bonus chest option: a chest of starter loot with up to four torches.
scope_reason: The oracle creates every world with new WorldSettings(seed, SURVIVAL, true, false, DEFAULT) (oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/Oracle.java) and never calls enableBonusChest, so WorldServer.createBonusChest is never reached.
notes: LootProbe.java records the bonusChest loot table, but no native code places the chest. Gates not re-run for this record; statuses rest on the probe and populate tests named in evidence.
